Create the following Go files for the plane-cli project. Follow the same patterns used in the existing commands at /Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/project/project.go and /Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/issue/issue.go.

Read those files first to understand the pattern, then create:

1. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/cycle/cycle.go` - Full CRUD + list-items, add-items, remove-item, transfer, archive, unarchive
   - API paths: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/cycles/` for CRUD
   - `cycles/{cycle_id}/cycle-work-items/` for items management
   - `cycles/{cycle_id}/transfer/` for transfer
   - `cycles/{cycle_id}/archive/` and `unarchive/` for archive ops
   - Table columns: ID, NAME, START_DATE(start_date), END_DATE(end_date), STATUS(status)
   - Create flags: --name (required), --description, --start-date, --end-date
   - Update flags: --name, --description, --start-date, --end-date  
   - add-items: takes --items flag (string slice of work item IDs), POSTs body `{"work_items": [...]}`
   - remove-item: takes <item-id> as arg, DELETEs at cycle-work-items/{item_id}/
   - transfer: POST to transfer/ with --new-cycle flag (target cycle ID)
   - archive/unarchive: POST to archive/ and unarchive/ respectively (no body)

2. `/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/module/module.go` - Full CRUD + list-items, add-items, remove-item, archive, unarchive
   - API paths: `workspaces/{workspace_slug}/projects/{project_id}/modules/` for CRUD
   - `modules/{module_id}/module-work-items/` for items management
   - `modules/{module_id}/archive/` and `unarchive/` for archive ops
   - Table columns: ID, NAME, START_DATE(start_date), TARGET_DATE(target_date), STATUS(status)
   - Create flags: --name (required), --description, --start-date, --target-date, --status, --lead, --members (string slice)
   - Update flags: --name, --description, --start-date, --target-date, --status, --lead, --members
   - add-items: takes --items flag (string slice of work item IDs), POSTs body `{"work_items": [...]}`
   - remove-item: takes <item-id> as arg, DELETEs at module-work-items/{item_id}/
   - archive/unarchive: POST to archive/ and unarchive/ respectively

- github.com/plane-cli/plane-cli/internal/cmdutil
- github.com/plane-cli/plane-cli/internal/output

content.text:
Confirmed -- the existing `cmd/project` package has the exact same errors, so the new files are syntactically correct. The build failures are a pre-existing repo dependency issue unrelated to the new code.

Here is a summary of what was created:

**`/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/cycle/cycle.go`** -- Package `cycle` with `NewCmd(f *cmdutil.Factory) *cobra.Command` exporting 11 subcommands:
- `list` -- Lists all cycles in a project
- `get <cycle-id>` -- Gets cycle details
- `create` -- Creates a cycle (flags: `--name` required, `--description`, `--start-date`, `--end-date`)
- `update <cycle-id>` -- Updates a cycle (flags: `--name`, `--description`, `--start-date`, `--end-date`, uses `cmd.Flags().Changed()` pattern)
- `delete <cycle-id>` -- Deletes a cycle
- `list-items <cycle-id>` -- Lists work items in a cycle via `cycle-work-items/`
- `add-items <cycle-id>` -- Adds work items via `--items` flag, POSTs `{"work_items": [...]}`
- `remove-item <cycle-id> <item-id>` -- DELETEs at `cycle-work-items/{item_id}/`
- `transfer <cycle-id>` -- POSTs to `transfer/` with `--new-cycle` flag
- `archive <cycle-id>` -- POSTs to `archive/` with no body
- `unarchive <cycle-id>` -- POSTs to `unarchive/` with no body

**`/Users/admin/project/plane-cli/cmd/module/module.go`** -- Package `module` with `NewCmd(f *cmdutil.Factory) *cobra.Command` exporting 10 subcommands:
- `list` -- Lists all modules in a project
- `get <module-id>` -- Gets module details
- `create` -- Creates a module (flags: `--name` required, `--description`, `--start-date`, `--target-date`, `--status`, `--lead`, `--members`)
- `update <module-id>` -- Updates a module (flags: `--name`, `--description`, `--start-date`, `--target-date`, `--status`, `--lead`, `--members`)
- `delete <module-id>` -- Deletes a module
- `list-items <module-id>` -- Lists work items via `module-work-items/`
- `add-items <module-id>` -- Adds work items via `--items` flag, POSTs `{"work_items": [...]}`
- `remove-item <module-id> <item-id>` -- DELETEs at `module-work-items/{item_id}/`
- `archive <module-id>` -- POSTs to `archive/` with no body
- `unarchive <module-id>` -- POSTs to `unarchive/` with no body

Both files follow the exact same patterns as the existing `project.go` and `issue.go` commands: same imports, same factory usage (`f.Client()`, `f.RequireWorkspaceAndProject()`), same `api.NewPath()` builder chain, same `output.FormatRaw()` for responses, and same `output.Println()` for deletion/action confirmations.
